title: Neon Drift
tagline: Steer a ribbon of light around tiny neon planets — eat orbs, grow longer, never touch your own glow.
description: A 3D take on the snake arcade classic played on the curved surface of little gridded planets. Steer left and right while a chase camera banks over the horizon, collect light orbs (gold ones are worth five) and watch your glowing trail grow. Charge three planets — Cobalt, Magenta and Solar — to light up the whole system. Portal mode adds paired wormhole gates that fling you across the globe; Duel is a two-player hotseat split-screen where the last light standing wins the round.
controls: ←/→ or A/D steer (Duel: P1 A/D, P2 ←/→) · touch: hold the left/right half of the screen or use the on-screen pads · Esc/P pause
fablePass: Music: driving synthwave bed with tempo tied to length
Head: animated comet flare + light-wake ripples on the grid
Finale: three charged planets orbiting in a camera flyby
Crash: slow-motion shatter of the trail into sparks
